heading: INT. DOUBLEWIDE TRAILER - LIVING ROOM - DAY

units.text: INT. DOUBLEWIDE TRAILER - LIVING ROOM - DAY
A cramped, wood-paneled room crowded with an old man's life: a recliner, a gun rack with no guns, stacks of National Geographic, a fish tank gone green.
Boxes labeled in marker line the walls.
FLORENCE, 60s, eldest, in a church dress, sits on the sofa with a legal pad.
EZEKIEL, 50s, her brother, stands at the window with his arms crossed.
DARIUS, 30s, a nephew in a work shirt, sits on a box.
LOLA, 20s, a niece in cutoffs, picks at the fish tank lid.
IGNATIUS, 40s, the lawyer in a cheap suit, stands by the door with a folder.
WANJIRU, 70s, Uncle Teodoro's long-time neighbor, sits very still in the recliner.
Mr. Ignatius, read the will.
units.name: FLORENCE

units.text: It's brief.
units.name: IGNATIUS

units.text: It always is.
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: "To my sister Florence, the clock. To my brother Ezekiel, the truck. To my nephew Darius, the tools. To my niece Lola, the fish."
units.name: IGNATIUS

units.text: The fish.
units.name: LOLA

units.text: He left her the fish.
units.name: DARIUS

units.text: The fish are dead.
units.name: LOLA

units.text: That's what you inherit, dear.
units.name: FLORENCE

units.text: Ezekiel turns from the window.
His jaw is tight.
And the land?
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: There is a final line.
units.name: IGNATIUS

units.text: Read it.
units.name: FLORENCE

units.text: "The land and the trailer I leave to Wanjiru, who stayed."
units.name: IGNATIUS

units.text: For a moment, no one moves.
Then Ezekiel strides across the room, grabs a stack of magazines, and hurls them against the wall.
They burst into a fan of glossy pages.
Darius leaps up, boxes toppling, and Lola scrambles back onto the sofa.
Florence stands, and Wanjiru does not.
Stayed? He stayed! We all stayed! We just stayed somewhere else!
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: Ezekiel, sit.
units.name: FLORENCE

units.text: No.
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: He kicks the nearest box.
It splits, and paperbacks tumble out.
Darius lunges for his arm, and the two stumble against the fish tank, which rocks, slops green water, and settles.
Ignatius backs against the door.
Wanjiru finally speaks.
He knew you would do this.
units.name: WANJIRU

units.text: Everyone stops.
They look at the old woman in the recliner.
She folds her hands.
That's why he told me where the key is.
units.name: WANJIRU

units.text: She opens her palm.
In it, a small brass key, tarnished and warm.
